name: Analogy & Simile Profiling
description: Analyzes the structural predictability and semantic distance of analogies and similes
mechanism: This method evaluates the creativity and semantic leap of analogies and similes within a text. LLMs tend to rely on highly conventional, statistically probable comparisons found abundantly in their training data (e.g., 'like a well-oiled machine', 'like a tapestry'). When prompted to be creative, AI analogies often mathematically align source and target domains too perfectly, lacking the chaotic, culturally-specific, or 'far-fetched' leaps characteristic of authentic human creativity. By measuring the semantic distance between the compared entities using vector embeddings, the system identifies structurally 'safe' or stereotyped analogies indicative of AI generation.
parameters:
Analysis type: Semantic vector distance
Media: Text
Input: Raw text string
Minimum length: 100 words
Output: Analogy predictability score (0-100)
Processing: Embedding cosine similarity
accuracy: Moderate — 65-80%. Highly effective on creative writing, marketing copy, and literature.
source: Cognitive linguistics and computational metaphor identification research.
useCase: Detecting AI-generated text masquerading as creative writing by identifying probabilistically safe, overused, and overly-perfect analogies.
strengths:
• Excellent at catching AI attempting to write fiction or creative essays
• Identifies lack of genuine out-of-distribution human creativity
• Independent of standard vocabulary analysis
limitations:
• Only triggers if the text actually contains analogies or similes
• May misclassify highly cliché human writing
• Requires computationally heavy semantic embeddings

references.title: Beigman Klebanov, B. et al. (2016). Semantic classifications for detection of verb metaphors. ACL.
